name: Inma no Mori Kara no Dasshutsu
source:
One day, a girl named "Vietta" finds herself lost in the LewDemon Forest.
A place where monsters salaciously roam for female prey.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ190670.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，一位名叫“维埃塔”的女孩发现自己在卢恶魔森林中迷路了。
怪物们为了雌性猎物而肆意游荡的地方。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ190670.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
